subject: Q3 Exec Slate: CRO sponsorship, comp-band confirmation, and HC release
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Q3 Exec Slate: CRO sponsorship, comp-band confirmation, and HC release

Team —

Quick summary: we have a strong final candidate for CRO (pipeline / enterprise sales leader). Recruiting and Greenwood have confirmed availability to start ~mid-July. Before we engage legal/comp committee and extend, I need two quick things signed off so we can move fast:

1) Headcount release for req RQ-4582 (Q3 executive slate). This is a new executive HC slot funded in Q3 strategic hiring (budget code HC-Q3-EXE-04).
2) Comp-band confirmation: recruiting recommends base up to $420,000 with a target OTE structured via bonus and 1.0% equity target (range 0.8–1.2%). Please confirm we can go to $420k base and the equity cadence.

Attachments: Q3_exec_slate_CRO_packet.pdf (role brief + comps), CRO_offer_model.xlsx (offer levers).
Related links: Greenhouse req: https://greenhouse.io/reqs/RQ-4582, offer model sheet link above.

Ask: Vivek — can you approve headcount release + indicate comp band comfort? Laura — can you confirm any additional approvals needed (comp committee / CFO) and whether the proposed band sits inside our executive band matrix? If so, please call out final band name and any special sign-off thresholds.

Timing: recruiting will need a green light to extend an offer by EOD Wednesday (5/12) to keep candidate engaged.

Thanks,
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Head of Sales Strategy
Redwood Inference

---

Marcus —

Thanks for the concise packet. Approve headcount release in principle and comfortable with up to $420k base given the role scope and revenue impact. Please route the final comps through the compensation committee for formal sign-off (cc Neha).

A couple asks: make sure finance sees HC-Q3-EXE-04 for budget code and include expected first-year OTE so we can forecast run-rate. Otherwise proceed to extend if recruiting confirms candidate timeline.

Vivek

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 12:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3 Exec Slate: CRO sponsorship, comp-band confirmation, and HC release

Marcus / Vivek —

Quick note from People/Comp: the proposed structure sits in Exec Band 5 (Executive Sales band). Summary from the comp-band matrix (attached):
- Exec Band 5: Base $380,000–$450,000; typical target = $410,000; upper threshold requires CFO approval if base > $400,000.
- Recommended offer: base $410k–420k, signing bonus discretionary, 1.0% target equity (standard 4yr vest / 1yr cliff).

Approvals needed: Vivek approval for HC release, and formal compensation committee notification. For any final base > $400k we need CFO (Neha) sign-off; I have cc'd Neha.

Attachment: comp-band-matrix-2027.csv (CSV table, 12KB)
Budget code / Finance note: HC-Q3-EXE-04. Please ensure recruiting marks forecast to Q3 hiring plan.

Laura Bennett
Head of People Operations
Redwood Inference

Marcus / Laura / Vivek —

Thanks for the update — quick candidate note from Greenwood: the final candidate (J. Carter) is aligned with a mid-May decision timeline and is comfortable with a start date of July 12. Candidate expectations: base in the $400k–$430k band, 1.0% equity, and standard severance / notice terms. They have one other late-stage process but prefer Redwood for the role if we move quickly.

Attached is the candidate resume and a short market comp note. If you want to give me the green light I will prepare an initial verbal and then formal written offer once comp approvals are finalized.

Attachment: greenwood_comp_note.txt (text, 6KB)

Cheers,

Thanks all — finalizing now.

Per Vivek’s in-principle and Laura’s comp-band guidance, I approve moving forward to extend a written offer with the following parameters:
- Base up to $420,000
- Target equity: 1.0% (4yr vest, 1yr cliff)
- Signing bonus: discretionary up to $30k
- First-year OTE: target ~ $620k (base + variable) — for forecasting to finance

Neha — please confirm CFO sign-off for base = $420k (this is above the $400k threshold Laura flagged). Once Neha confirms we’ll proceed: Ellen, please issue a verbal with the approved parameters and follow with a formal written offer. Legal/Comp will route final offer for signatures / DocuSign (link to draft: https://na1.app.box.com/s/docusign-draft-CRO).

Marcus
Marcus Lin
Head of Sales Strategy
Redwood Inference
